description: GEO-01C external spatial identity and conflation: design challenge and exact-diff review

weak_evidence_merge.instructions: An external observation could become a canonical link to a Zyara branch, or two Zyara facilities could be merged, on distance alone, on name alone, or by an automated actor without a deterministic identifier the provider declared.

criteria.true: Some link or merge can happen on weak evidence or without the required human/provider review
criteria.false: Only a provider-declared exact id in a linkable namespace can link automatically; spatial plus name evidence is only a proposal for human/provider review; ambiguous candidates stay distinct

namespace_bypass.instructions: An external id could be linked in a namespace that is unknown, not linkable (such as a geocoder), or with an id that does not match the namespace pattern, or the application role could add or change namespaces.

criteria.true: Some namespace rule can be bypassed
criteria.false: Namespaces are migrator-managed reference data and every link is checked against them in code and database

truth_overwrite.instructions: An external observation, a low-authority source, or a disappearance of an external POI could move, overwrite, hide or delete a Zyara location assertion, link or history, or a coordinate conflict could be silently closed.

criteria.true: External data or a weaker source can overwrite or delete Zyara truth or hide a conflict
criteria.false: External data only opens conflicts; corrections need authority, evidence and actor; history is append-only

abuse_controls.instructions: A single actor could make large coordinate moves or many corrections in a short window without an independent reviewer, or could supply a falsified moved distance, or bypass the limits by concurrency.

criteria.true: Large or bulk corrections can avoid review, or moved distance is client-trusted
criteria.false: Moves are measured by the database, large and bulk moves need a distinct reviewer, and limits hold under concurrency

scope_leak.instructions: A link, observation, conflict or correction could cross tenants or branches, reveal another tenant's data, or include patient, account or session location data or secrets.

criteria.true: Some cross-scope or privacy leak exists
criteria.false: Everything is tenant-scoped under RLS with composite FKs and carries facility data only

untested_requirement.instructions: Some handoff-required behaviour (nearby same-name distinct, namespace-bound exact id link, conflicts unresolved not overwritten, unlink preserves history, low-authority cannot overwrite verified, material move records evidence and actor, bulk edits rate-limited/reviewable) has no planned or implemented test.

criteria.false: Every required behaviour has a test in TypeScript or the PostGIS smoke
